name: Mortal Kombat: Armageddon — Johnny Cage Biography
notes: Official in-game Johnny Cage biography reproduced by Mortal Kombat Warehouse, which is used here as preservation/access infrastructure rather than canonical authority. Johnny describes Shinnok as someone his side had defeated years earlier and later states that Shinnok was back. The biography independently confirms a prior Original-continuity defeat of Shinnok, but it does not identify Liu Kang as the individual victor or provide a complete victor roster, exact battle location, or direct causal bridge from the renewed MK4 war to the defeat.
